items.title: NZX closes higher as banking stocks gain
items.content: New Zealand banking stocks led the market higher after stronger-than-expected quarterly earnings from major financial institutions.

items.title: Business confidence improves for fourth consecutive month
items.content: A nationwide survey showed business confidence continuing to recover as firms reported stronger sales expectations.

items.title: Retail spending increases during winter sales
items.content: Retailers reported stronger customer traffic as seasonal promotions boosted consumer spending across major cities.

items.title: Kiwi technology startups attract fresh investment
items.content: Several New Zealand technology startups secured funding to expand artificial intelligence and cloud-based services.

items.title: Construction sector records modest growth
items.content: Infrastructure projects supported construction activity despite higher material costs and labour shortages.

items.title: Renewable energy projects receive government support
items.content: Additional funding was announced for wind and solar energy developments to improve long-term energy security.

items.title: Export demand strengthens dairy industry outlook
items.content: Strong overseas demand for dairy products improved export expectations for the remainder of the year.

items.title: Commercial property market shows signs of recovery
items.content: Office occupancy rates increased as businesses gradually expanded operations in major business districts.

items.title: Healthcare providers increase digital investments
items.content: Hospitals and clinics accelerated digital transformation projects to improve patient services and operational efficiency.

items.title: Food manufacturers expand production capacity
items.content: Manufacturers announced new production lines to meet growing domestic and international demand.

items.title: Small businesses adopt AI tools to improve productivity
items.content: Local businesses are increasingly using AI-powered software to automate administrative tasks and customer support.

items.title: Inflation continues to ease as fuel prices decline
items.content: Lower transportation and energy costs contributed to a slower pace of inflation during the latest reporting period.
